observations.why: Imperative directive enacting authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a hierarchy-based allocation of what may be known.
Imperative command to purge knowledge enacts authority-ranking — the speaker claims the standing to order what the recipient must forget.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority to order what the recipient must know or forget, rather than merely sharing information?
